BFA.note: Document covers ID card production, not authentication.

facts.fact: ONI's director general cites the latest census, RGPH 2019, as the population base, giving 12,477,149 inhabitants aged 15 and over.

BFA.note: Share given for adults 15 and over only (10,308,006 of 12,477,149), not the whole population of all ages.
Document does not say who operates or owns the system platform.
No public register keyed on the ID number stated.

facts.fact: ONI's director general says 10,308,006 people aged 15 and over are enrolled in the ONI database with a valid CNIB, and ONI runs CNIB production centres in eight regions with a ninth planned at Banfora.

BFA.note: Says only that millions, including internally displaced people, lack a CNIB; no registration or digital service stated.
